t: How to send blessing on him
a: بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
p: Bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyatih, kamā bārakta ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd
m: Send blessing on Muhammad and his wives and his offspring, as You blessed the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
